events.title: 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 애스턴 빌라 3–0 to top the league with the First Division's only 100% record after three games. Crowd trouble interrupts the match between 코번트리 시티 and 레스터 시티 at Highfield Road . Peter Davenport scores a hat-trick as 노팅엄 포리스트 beat 선덜랜드 3–1 and 더비 카운티 's Kevin Wilson also scores three in his side's 3–2 win over 볼턴 원더러스 . Earlier in the week, Wilson scored four in a Milk Cup tie against 하틀리풀 유나이티드 .
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 drop their first points in a 2–0 defeat at 아스널. 토트넘 홋스퍼 have Graham Roberts and Clive Allen sent off as they lose 1–0 at 선덜랜드 .
노팅엄 포리스트 go top after a Trevor Christie hat-trick helps them to a resounding 5–0 win at 애스턴 빌라.

아스널 lead the First Division for the first time since February 1973 following their 3–1 win over 리버풀 at Highbury. 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 5–0 to register their first win after four draws. Billy Bonds makes his 700th league appearance by coming on as substitute in 웨스트햄 유나이티드's 2–0 win over 왓퍼드. Reading lose 4–1 to 동커스터 로버스 at Elm Park following a run of 29 home league games without defeat.

Clive Allen scores twice against his former club as 토트넘 홋스퍼 beat 퀸스 파크 레인저스 5–0 to displace North London rivals 아스널 from top spot. The Gunners are beaten 2–1 at 입스위치 타운 . At Stamford Bridge , 첼시's Colin Lee sees his penalty saved by 웨스트햄 유나이티드 keeper Tom McAlister but scores from the rebound. Referee Trevor Spencer orders a retake – Lee's second effort is also saved but he again scores from the rebound. The home side go on to win 3–0.
노팅엄 포리스트 return to the top with a 3–1 win over 루턴 타운 at the City Ground .

Back in European competition for the first time in eight years, 퀸스 파크 레인저스 enjoy a 3–0 first leg win over KR Reykjavík in the UEFA Cup . Second Division leaders 버밍엄 시티 drop their first points of the season, beaten 1–0 at home by 포츠머스 .

리버풀 begin their defence of the European Cup with a 1–0 win over Lech Poznań in Poland . In the UEFA Cup, 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 enjoy comfortable wins but 노팅엄 포리스트 and 사우샘프턴 both draw at home. 에버턴 are surprisingly held by University College Dublin in the Cup Winners' Cup . The last two 100% league records come to an end as 헤리퍼드 유나이티드 draw with 체스터 시티 and 체스터필드 lose at 하틀리풀 유나이티드.
Dutch club 포르튀나 시타르트 makes its European debut with a draw (0-0) against Denmark's BK 코펜하겐 in the first round of the Cup Winners Cup .

Aggregate attendances are the lowest of the season so far but there is no shortage of goals. 퀸스 파크 레인저스 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 draw an extraordinary match 5–5 at Loftus Road . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 led 4–0 at half-time with 크리스 워들 contributing a hat-trick. 볼턴 원더러스 beat 플리머스 아가일 7–2 with Tony Caldwell scoring three. John Deehan scores a hat-trick in 노리치 시티's 3–2 win over 왓퍼드 at Carrow Road. In the same fixture last season, Deehan scored four.
Milk Cup holders 리버풀 are held to a goalless draw in the first leg of their second round tie with 스톡포트 카운티 at Edgeley Park .
노팅엄 포리스트 are the only First Division side beaten in tonight's Milk Cup matches, losing 1–0 at 포츠머스. John Barnes scores a hat-trick as 왓퍼드 win for the first time this season, beating 카디프 시티 3–1.

Struggling 스토크 시티 lose 2–1 at home to 로더럼 유나이티드 in the Milk Cup. Young Welsh forward 마크 휴스 scores his first senior hat-trick in 맨체스터 유나이티드's 4–0 win over 번리 . Garth Crooks also scores three as league leaders 토트넘 홋스퍼 win 5–1 at Halifax Town .

Another day of high scoring in today's fixtures – 153 goals at an average of more than three per match. 플리머스 아가일 beat 프레스턴 노스 엔드 6–4 and 에버턴 win by the odd goal in nine at 왓퍼드 who slip to the bottom of the First Division. 리즈 유나이티드 beat 올덤 애슬레틱 6–0 with Andy Ritchie scoring three. Other hat-trick heroes include Gary Stevens of 슈루즈버리 타운 and 반즐리 's David Geddis . 팻 제닝스 marks his 750th league appearance by saving a Kenny Hibbitt penalty in 아스널's 2–1 win at 코번트리 시티. 리버풀 in turmoil – Grobbelaar has a nightmare as 셰필드 웬즈데이 beat them 2–0 at Anfield . The champions have won only two of their eight league matches this season.
